description: This file defines a template class StringTokenizerT for tokenizing strings, with examples and options for handling delimiters and quotes. It provides methods for iterating over tokens and configuring tokenizer behavior.

classes.name: StringTokenizerT
classes.description: A template class for tokenizing strings with support for delimiters, quotes, and options.

methods.name: GetNext
methods.description: Advances the tokenizer to the next token or delimiter.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the tokenizer to start from the beginning.

methods.name: token
methods.description: Returns the current token as a string.
